title: The YML for Yandex Market plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to,…
description: The YML for Yandex Market plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 5.10.0 contains a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive information. Specifically, attackers can extract the merchant's plaintext Yandex Market API key from a publicly accessible log file. This exposure requires that the plugin's y4ym_keeplogs option is enabled and that a Yandex Market API key is stored, conditions that are typical in normal plugin usage.
